instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: ProxyHarbor Care Access overview: The project registers, verifies, restricts, and revokes patient-authorized proxy access. Patients nominate proxies, identify them, select covered care areas, and may revoke active authorizations. Authorization clerks verify patient requests and proxy identities before activation and record revocations before further access; active proxies may view appointment details; and privacy reviewers record restrictions. Verification evidence, automatic expiration, and responsibility for disputed restrictions are unresolved. Stakeholders also disagree on access to care-plan summaries.

output.summary: ProxyHarbor Care Access registers, verifies, restricts, and revokes patient-authorized proxy access. Patients define and revoke authorizations, Authorization Clerks perform verification and activation controls, active Care Proxies may view appointment details, and Privacy Reviewers record restrictions. Verification evidence, expiration behavior, disputed-restriction ownership, and access to care-plan summaries remain unresolved.
output.primary_goal: Register, verify, restrict, and revoke patient-authorized proxy access.
key_capabilities: Nominate Care Proxies and select covered care areas.
Verify patient requests and Care Proxy identities before activation.
Allow active Care Proxies to view appointment details.
Revoke active authorizations and record revocations before further access.
unresolved_points: Which evidence is accepted for authorization verification.
Which role resolves disputed access restrictions.
Whether an active Care Proxy may view care-plan summaries.
